name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
description: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the flagship national public health insurance fund of the Government of India that provides free health coverage for secondary and tertiary healthcare hospitalizations to low income citizens.
benefits: Provides cashless and paperless health coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across all empaneled public and private hospitals nationwide. Covers up to 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days of post-hospitalization expenses including diagnostic tests and medicines.
eligibility: Targeted at families identified based on deprivation and occupational criteria as per the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 database. There is no restriction on family size, age, or gender.
documents: Official documents include Aadhaar card or Ration card, government-issued photo ID proof, and an active mobile number for authentication and Golden Card generation.
application_process: Check eligibility online at mera.pmjay.gov.in or visit a nearby Common Service Center (CSC) or empaneled hospital. Carry Aadhaar Card and Ration Card to the Ayushman Mitra help desk, undergo biometric e-KYC verification, and receive the Ayushman Golden Card.
